# Round 4 recorded announcement days

These are DOM excerpts of the real Round 3 `/recent` recording. Dates, paper
IDs, titles and authors are unchanged. The wrappers let the `/new` parser replay
the recorded Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday batches. Provenance, selection counts
and hashes are in `provenance.json`; the original full page remains in Round 3.

The delayed 2026-11-17 case uses Round 3's unchanged `arxiv-new.html`, which
actually still showed Monday 16 November when recorded on Tuesday morning.

No historical Tuesday/Wednesday `/new` response can be retrieved from today's
`/new` URL. The other tests control when each recorded day becomes visible.
`arxiv-merged-recent.html` selects the recorded Wednesday and Monday blocks to
simulate Tuesday being merged into Wednesday. It is not a claim that the real
November 10 announcement was missing; the full source also contains Tuesday.
No new network requests were required.
